Fetching questions…

📋 How to use exported files

1. Click a module button above to download its quiz HTML file.
2. Copy the file onto the pen drive into the correct folder.
3. Replace the old quiz file with the new one — keep the same filename.
4. Open in any browser to confirm questions load correctly.

📖 Question Writing Guidelines

Please read before submitting to ensure questions meet NAAD standards.

✅ Good Questions

✔ Factually accurate — based on official agency guidelines and national safety standards
✔ Four plausible options — all four answers should seem possible to a student
✔ One clear correct answer — no ambiguity
✔ Strong explanation — clearly explain WHY the answer is correct with facts or laws
✔ Scenario-based — e.g. "A student sees smoke — what should they do?"

❌ Avoid These

✗ Trick questions or deliberately confusing wording
✗ Questions where two or more answers could be correct
✗ Politically sensitive or culturally inappropriate content
✗ Duplicate questions already in the NAAD system

🛡️ General Safety — Auto-Generated Module

This module is automatically assembled from all approved agency questions. The system picks the best-balanced set — ideally 2–3 questions from each agency — to create a cross-agency safety overview.

🎓 Student Safety — Cadet Media Ghana Exclusive

This module is solely managed by CMG. Only the CMG administrator can submit questions for this module, as it deals directly with student welfare and campus safety content.

📘 Academic — General Academic Aptitude Quiz

A practice quiz (Maths, English, Science, Social Studies, Computing) that sits at the top of the pendrive menu beside the General quiz. Managed by CMG: choose Academic as the module when adding questions (pictures are supported), approve them, then export academic_quiz.html from the Export tab. Up to 60 questions.
